note: Reviewed people_id to candidate map for New York's 2025-2026 General Assembly (LegiScan session 2188). Every serving member appears exactly once: a candidate id where a human confirmed the identity, or null where a human confirmed there is no November 2026 candidate row to map. The two sponsor pseudo-people the dataset carries (people_id 1483 and 1484, both named "Budget" with a blank district) are left out, because they are not members and the resolver does not count them. Fifty entries come from the proposer, which matched them on first and last name with the seat agreeing, and all fifty were accepted. Five are hand-added: our roster stores those five sitting members with the surname first ("Barrett, Didi"), which no name rule can match, and each was confirmed by the district. The 164 nulls are members with no November 2026 candidate row, which is expected while New York's roster campaign is still filling seats in parallel; extending this file later and re-importing adds those members without duplicating anything.
